qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: While John Crane holds niche switching barriers in mechanical seals (~24% division operating margins) and Flex-Tek has specialized engineered components, group-level historical GAAP ROIC (~7-9%) persistently fails the 12% hurdle across cycles, diluted by legacy conglomerate acquisitions, asbestos liabilities, and lack of enterprise pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Multi-cycle statutory GAAP ROIC (~7-9%) trails the 12% Munger hurdle; loose conglomerate structure has suffered decades of underperformance, legacy asbestos liabilities, and dilutive capital allocation.
qualitative.evidence: Statutory ROIC hovers around 7% vs WACC of ~11.5%. Despite strong division margins in John Crane seals, group returns on total invested capital fail Munger hurdle across multi-year cycles, driving activist pressure and ongoing breakup/divestment transactions.
